purpose: Define Triggers as explicit canonical predicates/bindings over Events, values, state changes or timing conditions, with no execution until the trigger condition resolves true.

topics.name: Trigger Binding
topics.purpose: Define Triggers as explicit canonical predicates/bindings over Events, values, state changes or timing conditions, with no execution until the trigger condition resolves true.

semantics.predicate_rule: Trigger predicate is explicit and side-effect-free.
semantics.target_rule: Trigger references an explicit downstream Runner, Routine, command or canonical operation.
semantics.payload_rule: Trigger may pass validated occurrence/context data to its target but cannot let payload choose arbitrary target identity.
semantics.state_rule: Trigger runtime state such as last-seen/onchange memory is separate from trigger definition.
semantics.authority_rule: Satisfied predicate does not bypass target authorization.
semantics.multiplicity_rule: One Event/source may feed multiple Triggers and one Trigger may belong to multiple Topics.

invariants.rule: Automation semantics remain explicit across Event, Trigger, Runner and Routine identities, and execution order never derives from incidental structure or serialization order.

hard_gates.condition: trigger state stored as canonical definition
trigger target inferred from tree adjacency

references.purpose: Triggers may bind to explicit Events.
